methods.label: Transfer the corresponding side
methods.explanation: $BD=CD$, $\angle ADB=\angle EDC$ (vertically opposite angles), and $AD=ED$, so $\triangle ABD\cong\triangle ECD$ (SAS). Thus, $CE=AB=7$.
